entities.name: Creation of the Schism
entities.description: Event in Utvara Valley where a mana bomb tore a spatial fold in Ravnica.

entities.name: Schism
entities.description: Glimmering rupture in Ravnica that draws souls into Agyrem.

entities.name: Kaluzax
entities.description: Low-ranking Izzet goblin artificer who piloted the observosphere carrying the mana bomb and became a ghost.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: Izzet Magelord who ordered the mission.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild that deployed the mana bomb.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: Guild whose squatters spread the plague; a Gruul warband attacked the observosphere.

entities.name: Utvara Valley
entities.description: Region on Ravnica where the kuga plague spread.

entities.name: Kuga plague
entities.description: Virulent arcano-biological contagion resistant to purification magic.

entities.name: Agyrem
entities.description: Spectral pocket-realm snagged by the Schism.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: Guild that traveled to Utvara to create a cure.

entities.name: Selesnya
entities.description: Guild that planted the Vitar Yescu.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: Guild drawn to the soulless corpses.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: Guild that bought land in Utvara to rent out.

events.summary: The Izzet League, on Zomaj Hauc's orders, sends Kaluzax to drop a prototype mana bomb on the plague-ridden Utvara zone.
events.quote: Kaluzax was sent on this mission by his boss, Chief Observer Valuzax

events.summary: A Gruul warband attacks and badly damages Kaluzax's observosphere.
events.quote: managed to badly damage the vessel

events.summary: The bomb detonates mid-air, with catastrophic and unprecedented results.
The explosion tears open the Schism; every soul in Utvara is ripped from its body and the Schism snags Agyrem.
events.quote: every soul in Utvara was ripped from their bodies

events.summary: Kaluzax dies in the crash and awakens as a ghost in Agyrem.
events.quote: Kaluzax himself perished in the crash

events.summary: The Schism mutates the plague into an airborne plague wind; the guilds respond.

relations.quote: Kaluzax was sent on this mission by his boss, Chief Observer Valuzax
The event known simply as The Schism began with a single Izzet goblin on a mission
on orders of Magelord Zomaj Hauc himself
